interpretations: Compute one row for all films with `film.length >= 112`: the average `film.length`, followed by the average of the per-film ratio `film.replacement_cost / film.rental_rate`. Ignore missing values separately for each average, return a missing value if an average has no values, and do not round.
queries:
SELECT
  AVG(length),
  AVG(replacement_cost / NULLIF(rental_rate, 0))
FROM film
WHERE length >= 112
